_description: Reference data from FGD ATC'23 paper. Figs 7a, 7b, 9b manually traced (random/clustering/fgd only). Others are approximate OCR readings. X-axis 'demand_pct' = Arrived workloads in % of cluster GPU capacity.
_source: Weng et al., 'Beware of Fragmentation: Scheduling GPU-Sharing Workloads with Fragmentation Gradient Descent', ATC'23
_cluster: Cluster H: 1213 nodes, 6212 GPUs (T4, P100, V100, G2, G3, A10)

fig7a_frag_rate_pct._description: Frag Rate (%) - manually traced (random, clustering, fgd). null = point not clearly readable.
fig7a_frag_rate_pct._x_axis: Arrived workloads (% of cluster GPU capacity)

fig7b_frag_over_total_pct._description: Frag/Total (%) - manually traced (random, clustering, fgd). null = point not clearly readable.
fig7b_frag_over_total_pct._x_axis: Arrived workloads (% of cluster GPU capacity)

fig9a_unalloc_gpu_pct._description: Unallocated GPU (%) - fraction of total GPUs not allocated. Our 'alloc_ratio' = 1 - (unalloc_pct/100). All traces start at ~25% unallocated at x=75.
fig9a_unalloc_gpu_pct._x_axis: Arrived workloads (% of cluster GPU capacity)

fig9b_occupied_nodes._description: Occupied GPU nodes - manually traced (random, clustering, fgd).
fig9b_occupied_nodes._x_axis: Arrived workloads (% of cluster GPU capacity)

fig9c_pending_gpus_at_96pct._description: Total GPU-equivalents of pending (rejected) tasks when cumulative demand reaches 96% of capacity. Broken down by task GPU request size. Read carefully from stacked bar chart.

fig9d_frag_breakdown_pct._description: Breakdown of fragmented GPUs into three categories (percentages of total fragmented GPUs, sums to 100%). 'non_gpu' = fragmented due to non-GPU resource shortage (CPU/mem). 'stranded' = GPU available but unreachable due to scheduling topology. 'deficient' = GPU capacity too small for pending tasks.

_validation_checks.policy_ordering_frag_at_100pct_demand: Random > DotProd > Clustering > Packing ~ BestFit > FGD
